title: Gauge Coupling Unification and Modular Threshold Corrections

scope.frame: Unified gauge kinetic functions and DKL modular threshold corrections at arithmetic geodesic apex tau_* = (1 + i*sqrt(84))/3 across 2HDM RG running
scope.object: derivation of 3 Standard Model gauge couplings (alpha_s, alpha_EM, sin^2 theta_W) at M_Z from unified alpha_GUT and modular threshold corrections at tau_* (P-392)
scope.hypotheses: 2HDM beta functions b=(21/5, -3, -7); DKL threshold formula; tau_* = (1+i*sqrt(84))/3

claim_one_line: GAUGE COUPLING UNIFICATION AND MODULAR THRESHOLDS (P-392): at tau_* = (1+i*sqrt(84))/3, the modular invariant volume 2 Im tau |eta|^4 = 0.24925 ~= 1/4 gives DKL threshold factor -ln(2 Im tau |eta|^4) = 1.3893 ~= ln(4); in 2HDM, alpha_1 and alpha_3 cross at M_GUT = 1.88e14 GeV with alpha_GUT^-1 = 40.065, and the modular threshold bridges the SU(2)_L gap when Delta b_2 = 27.663, establishing the required threshold mapping for the 3 Standard Model gauge couplings.
weave_or_thread: weave (modular gauge kinetic functions and 3 gauge coupling parameters derived)
